doc.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Opening and introductions
summary: Kimery introduces the interview at the Jazz Showcase in Chicago and asks Segal to start at the beginning.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.

Ken Kimery: My name is Ken Kimery. I am the program producer of the Smithsonian’s Jazz Masterworks Orchestra and Jazz Oral History Program. I’m here in wonderful Chicago at the Jazz Showcase on October 6, 2014 with NEA Jazz Master, proprietor of the Jazz Showcase, and all around revered talent I would say, because you are into talent.
You have to identify talent that comes in this venue here at the Jazz Showcase. So if we can start in the beginning here, because this is really important in setting the stage there.
If you can give me your full birth name, and birth date and birth year.
